sentences.text: This study compared 42 people with spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 to 17 healthy controls, splitting participants into groups based on ataxia severity and cognitive status.

Individuals with the condition exhibited difficulties with executive function, visual working memory, and spatial planning, with those having moderate-to-severe ataxia showing worse visual working memory and task accuracy than those with mild ataxia.

While patients with intact cognition took longer to process information, only those with cognitive impairment had issues with delayed responses, and specific cerebellar regions were linked to different cognitive abilities.
The authors conclude that the cognitive problems in this condition are linked to changes in specific parts of the cerebellum.
